rationale: Playbook PG-EXF-001 matched on alert ALRT-0001. The principal eve.contractor@eproc.test operating as database role analyst_ro read 2 statements against public.vendors between 2026-08-04T22:14:00Z and 2026-08-04T22:20:00Z. The standing playbook for bulk sensitive reads revokes the read grant that was used, terminates the live backend, and preserves the statement sample for the investigator.
rollback:
GRANT SELECT ON public.vendors TO analyst_ro;
DELETE FROM incident_hold WHERE alert_id = 'ALRT-0001';

alert_summary.rule_name: Unbounded read of sensitive employee or vendor columns

evidence.statement: SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, tax_id, bank_account FROM vendors
SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, tax_id, bank_account, owner_name FROM vendors ORDER BY vendor_id

baseline_context.note: Role analyst_ro normally returns about 3947 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
